object:coin / generic coin.visualDescription: A single large pale dollar sign with thick dark pixel edges fills the cell. It is a currency symbol rather than a coin with a visible face.
object:coin / generic coin.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the gold piece as NetHack's coinage, valued in zorkmids. This generic class tile gives no stamped design or pile size.
object:coin / generic coin.modelBrief: Use a shallow cream-colored dollar-sign marker with a heavy dark edge for the generic slot. Reserve round coins or piles for an appearance-specific tile.

object:gem / generic gem.visualDescription: A large cream asterisk has uneven pointed arms and a dark blue-gray outline. There is no cut-stone shape or color in the tile.
object:gem / generic gem.wikiDescription: NetHack gems include several kinds of small stones, some valuable and some not. This is the class marker, not an identified jewel.
object:gem / generic gem.modelBrief: Make a flat multi-pointed asterisk token with an open readable silhouette and cream face. Do not assign a gemstone cut, hue, or value to this generic marker.

object:large rock / generic large rock.visualDescription: A short, pale curved stroke resembling a backtick or small rock-class mark sits near the middle. It is not a rendered boulder.
object:large rock / generic large rock.wikiDescription: The wiki describes boulders as heavy rock objects that occupy dungeon squares. This tile is the generic large-rock class sign, not evidence for a particular stone surface.
object:large rock / generic large rock.modelBrief: Give the small hooked mark shallow depth as a class icon. Avoid building a full boulder from this abstract glyph alone; the actual boulder tile supplies that model reference.

object:iron ball / generic iron ball.visualDescription: A pale zero-like oval with a dark blue-gray interior and thick outline sits at center. It reads as a class symbol rather than a shaded sphere.
object:iron ball / generic iron ball.wikiDescription: The heavy iron ball is NetHack's iron-ball object type and is made of iron. The generic glyph gives only a circular cue, not a physical size or chain attachment.
object:iron ball / generic iron ball.modelBrief: If this class placeholder needs a 3D form, use a low-relief oval ring with a dark inset. Keep the full iron ball model for its object tile and do not attach an invented chain here.

object:iron chain / generic iron chain.visualDescription: A short, thick cream horizontal bar with a dark blue-gray lower edge crosses part of the cell. No separate links are drawn.
object:iron chain / generic iron chain.wikiDescription: An iron chain is a NetHack item associated with attaching a heavy iron ball. This class glyph supplies no link count or construction detail.
object:iron chain / generic iron chain.modelBrief: Use one shallow horizontal bar for the fallback class glyph; avoid interpreting it as a measured chain segment. A later physical chain model can use actual links while keeping this tile distinct.

object:venom / generic venom.visualDescription: One pale square-ish dot with a dark lower-right pixel shadow floats at center. It shows no splash, bottle, or creature.
object:venom / generic venom.wikiDescription: Venom is a NetHack object class for poisonous or acidic projectiles produced by monsters. This generic point is not a particular venom type.
object:venom / generic venom.modelBrief: Keep a tiny raised dot for the placeholder icon. Do not infer a color, container, or blob anatomy from this abstract tile.

object:arrow.visualDescription: A long brown wooden shaft runs diagonally from lower left to upper right, ending in a small pale arrowhead; a dark rear point suggests fletching.
object:arrow.wikiDescription: An arrow is stackable ammunition fired from a bow. The wiki distinguishes ordinary arrows from elven, orcish, silver, and ya varieties that follow it in the atlas.
object:arrow.modelBrief: Make a slender straight brown shaft, small pale metal point, and minimal dark fletching. Match the diagonal reference silhouette without embedding the patterned floor.

object:runed arrow / elven arrow.visualDescription: A brown diagonal shaft carries a vivid pale-green arrowhead and a dark lower-left tail. The tile's runed quality is conveyed by color more than legible markings.
object:runed arrow / elven arrow.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an elven arrow as wooden bow ammunition that appears as a runed arrow when unidentified. The appearance label names the visible tile; no readable rune is evident in the sprite.
object:runed arrow / elven arrow.modelBrief: Keep the ordinary arrow proportions but add the distinct green-tinted point and restrained elven finish. Do not invent large symbols on this tiny design.

object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.visualDescription: A rough, dark brown shaft leans diagonally; the far upper-right end is broad and blunt-looking, while the near end is a small pale tip. It is much darker than the ordinary arrow.
object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.wikiDescription: An orcish arrow is projectile ammunition for an orcish bow and appears as a crude arrow. Its crude label supports rough construction, while the dark palette is from PixelHack.
object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.modelBrief: Use a slim but uneven wooden shaft with dark coarse fletching and a small light point. Keep it visibly rougher and browner than the standard arrow.

object:silver arrow.visualDescription: A cool gray-blue diagonal shaft with a light ivory tip and dark tail mirrors the ordinary arrow's length. Its metal-colored body is the main distinction.
object:silver arrow.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the silver arrow as a projectile made of silver. Its material matters in NetHack; the sprite uses pale gray to distinguish it from wooden arrows.
object:silver arrow.modelBrief: Use the regular arrow silhouette, replacing the warm shaft with silver-gray metal and a bright pale point. Keep the narrow proportions legible at tile scale.

object:bamboo arrow / ya.visualDescription: A short ochre-brown diagonal shaft has a pale point and darker lower-left tail. The warm bamboo color separates it from the gray silver arrow.
object:bamboo arrow / ya.wikiDescription: A ya is an arrow designed for the yumi and appears as a bamboo arrow when unidentified. The wiki specifies a metal head and bamboo shaft.
object:bamboo arrow / ya.modelBrief: Model a light bamboo shaft with a compact metal point and dark fletching. Keep the sprite's warm ochre tone and shorter, sturdy appearance.

object:crossbow bolt.visualDescription: A compact dark-brown diagonal dart has a blunt-looking rear and small dark head, noticeably shorter and thicker than the arrows above it.
object:crossbow bolt.wikiDescription: Crossbow bolts are stackable projectiles made to be fired by a crossbow. The wiki treats them as ammunition distinct from bow arrows.
object:crossbow bolt.modelBrief: Build a short stout wooden bolt with understated dark fletching and point. Compare its length against arrow tile 807 so it reads as crossbow ammunition.
